projects.evaluation: re-gazetted with same threshold in 2017 (2034/33) -> enforcement gap; CEA 2026: old fine Rs 100,000 'cheap enough that offenders would pay it and resume'

projects.name: Pilisaru National Solid Waste Management Project
projects.evaluation: Auditor General 2010: SWM provision Rs 2.08bn (2008-10), actual Rs 770M (utilisation 29% in 2009, 59% in 2010); 9,240 compost bins missing from books. AG 2012: 5 large yards cost Rs 415M, received far less garbage than planned, carrier belts 'inoperative within ... 2 1/2 months', machines idle. AG 2013: Medirigiriya yard got 2 tractor loads/day vs target. UoM 2021: of 20 sites, 7 >75% performance, 5 <50%.

projects.name: National Environmental (Municipal Solid Waste) Regulations No. 1 of 2009
